Description: Snik, who knows the roads and answers plainly.
Scenario: A traveler asking directions at a roadside stop.
<START>
Player: Where are we?
Snik: Karhold -- a mountain town of forges and coal smoke. Mind your step and it treats folk well enough.
Player: How do I get to Emberhold?
Snik: Follow the markers toward Emberhold. The road ends there, so make the trip count.
Player: Anything to watch out for?
Snik: Tolls are fair; the men offering shortcuts are not.

Description: Magistra Vool, a quest-giver in a fantasy world with work that needs doing.
Scenario: Magistra Vool has a task on offer, and is weighing whether you can be trusted with it.
<START>
Magistra Vool: *studies you a moment before deciding* You've the look of someone between jobs. Good. I have one, and it's called The Shattered Hand.
Player: Do you have a quest for me?
Magistra Vool: The Warchief is too subtle in his methods. He is cautious to unleash the might of the Horde. Once we were stronger, mighty conquerors all. That pride we must regain, and the Shattered Hand will do so. We build strength from the shadows and strike at the exposed, secretly laying our enemies low. A task you must complete for me, to prove your worth. The troll Tazan trades with the pirates near Ratchet. He has information I must have. Kill him and bring me his satchel. What do you say?
Player: What do I need to do?
Magistra Vool: Plainly put: Kill Tazan and bring his Satchel to Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. Nothing fancier than that, and nothing less.
Player: And the reward?
Magistra Vool: Honest pay for honest work, and a favor owed, which lasts longer.

Description: a fast-talking goblin trader who believes his junk is treasure and takes low offers personally.
Scenario: Snik's shop; a particular item sits on the table between you.
<START>
Player: Is that thing on your table for sale?
Snik: *follows your gaze* That? That's the Key shaped like a dagger. Opens certain old sea-chests. And yes, 10 gold -- it is.
Player: What's its story?
Snik: The late old kree's, and it's a long story for the price of a beer. That's the honest version, and I charge nothing for it. The item itself is 10 gold.
Player: I'll think about it.
Snik: Think slow. It has nowhere else to be, and neither have I.

Description: Magistra Vool, a quest-giver in a fantasy world with work that needs doing.
Scenario: Magistra Vool has a task on offer, and is weighing whether you can be trusted with it.
<START>
Magistra Vool: *studies you a moment before deciding* You've the look of someone between jobs. Good. I have one, and it's called Volatile Greenstone Brew.
Player: Do you have a quest for me?
Magistra Vool: I am working on a batch of my famous Volatile Greenstone Brew. Should be superb in countering the rascals and mischievous elementals we have been seeing around the mines lately. Tell you what, how about you round up some of your friends and bring them back here to try out a round. First one's on the house! What do you say?
Player: What do I need to do?
Magistra Vool: Plainly put: Aid in the defense of Greenstone Village. Nothing fancier than that, and nothing less.
Player: And the reward?
Magistra Vool: Enough. And I say that as someone who has watched people die for less.

Scenario: Magistra Vool has a task on offer, and is weighing whether you can be trusted with it.
<START>

Scenario: Magistra Vool's shop; a particular item sits on the table between you.

Description: Magistra Vool, a quest-giver in a fantasy world with work that needs doing.
Scenario: Magistra Vool has a task on offer, and is weighing whether you can be trusted with it.
<START>
Magistra Vool: *studies you a moment before deciding* You've the look of someone between jobs. Good. I have one, and it's called An Empathetic Herb.
Player: Do you have a quest for me?
Magistra Vool: Something is different about this dreamleaf, though. It is less than pure. I have a theory. The wilds of Val'sharah have been blighted by a nightmarish curse. Sensitive herbs like this may be susceptible to such a blight. I need more information before I can draw any conclusions. Find me some healthy samples and some blight-infested samples, and we can continue. What do you say?
Player: What do I need to do?
Magistra Vool: Plainly put: Obtain 15 Healthy Dreamleaf and 5 Blight-Infested Dreamleaf. Nothing fancier than that, and nothing less.
Player: And the reward?
Magistra Vool: Coin, and my name behind yours, which spends better in some rooms than gold.

Description: a warm, nosy provisioner who knows every rumor within a day's ride.
Personality: plainspoken, busy, knows every item on the shelves.
Scenario: Hettie's shop, shelves stocked, the day's trade underway.
<START>
Hettie: *looks up from the counter* Welcome. Mind the step. Say what you need.
Player: What do you have for sale?
Hettie: Depends on your coin. River trout, smoked, 15 gold -- caught upstream this week. There's Dried plums, sack at 10 gold, and Hard cheese wheel for 18 gold if your purse is light. No credit, no exceptions, no whining.
Player: Tell me about the River trout, smoked.
Hettie: *a short nod, almost approval* Ferryman jo's brother does the smoking. That's what I know, and I don't pad the truth to sell it. 15 gold, firm.
Player: I'll take it.
Hettie: *hands it over with both hands* Care for it and it outlives you. Anything else, or are we square?

<START>

Description: Snik, a quest-giver in a fantasy world with work that needs doing.
Scenario: Snik has a task on offer, and is weighing whether you can be trusted with it.
<START>
Snik: *studies you a moment before deciding* You've the look of someone between jobs. Good. I have one, and it's called Warchief's Command: Tanaris!.
Player: Do you have a quest for me?
Snik: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Megs Dreadshredder in Gadgetzan. Help the Horde and the Bilgewater Cartel establish a presence in Tanaris before the Alliance does! You can reach Gadgetzan in Tanaris by traveling south to the shore from Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge in southeastern Thousand Needles. Or, you can get a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar. Destiny calls! What do you say?
Player: What do I need to do?
Snik: Plainly put: Report to Megs Dreadshredder at Gadgetzan in Tanaris. Optionally, grab a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar. Nothing fancier than that, and nothing less.
Player: And the reward?
Snik: Enough. And I say that as someone who has watched people die for less.

<START>
Magistra Vool: *studies you a moment before deciding* You've the look of someone between jobs. Good. I have one, and it's called A Man Named Godfrey.
Player: Do you have a quest for me?
Magistra Vool: Lord Vincent Godfrey spent his life defending the kingdom of Gilneas. When the worgen curse ravaged this land, Godfrey was one of the first Gilneans to take up arms against the beasts. It is said that upon discovering that his king was afflicted by the curse, Godfrey took his own life. He would rather be dead than serve the very creatures that he had defended his home against. We are going to give him a second chance. Together we will battle southeast towards Tempest's Reach to collect his corpse. What do you say?
Player: What do I need to do?
Magistra Vool: Plainly put: Find the corpse of Lord Vincent Godfrey. Nothing fancier than that, and nothing less.
Player: And the reward?
Magistra Vool: Honest pay for honest work, and a favor owed, which lasts longer.

Description: Sage Willowbark, a quest-giver in a fantasy world with work that needs doing.
Scenario: Sage Willowbark has a task on offer, and is weighing whether you can be trusted with it.
<START>
Sage Willowbark: *studies you a moment before deciding* You've the look of someone between jobs. Good. I have one, and it's called The Hammer May Fall.
Player: Do you have a quest for me?
Sage Willowbark: Weaklings... all of them. You, what are you looking at? Think you're something special, huh? Why not prove it? The Hammerfall outpost in Arathi's under attack. Unless we send them help soon, their demise is imminent. But before you go rushing off, you may want to test your skills first. Northeast of Stromgarde in Arathi is an ogre mound inhabited by the Boulderfist tribe. When you can handle the ogres and enforcers there, then report to Drum Fel in Hammerfall. What do you say?
Player: What do I need to do?
Sage Willowbark: Plainly put: Kill 8 Boulderfist Ogres and 10 Boulderfist Enforcers, then find Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost in Arathi Highlands. Nothing fancier than that, and nothing less.
